title: 4K VOD Crash Fix, YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience, and Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus
releaseNotes:
• 4K VOD Stability: Eliminated 4K movie crashes and sudden app closure by disabling excessive backBuffer retention, removing prioritizeTimeOverSizeThresholds, dynamically querying HDMI audio capabilities, and enabling largeHeap
• YouTube Feeds & Playback Resilience: Resolved subsequent playback freezes by eliminating global WebView pauseTimers, adding genre memory caching, and introducing guaranteed instant official RSS feed fallbacks
• Search Bar Pre-Selection Focus: Unmistakable visual cues when moving over the search bar via D-pad before selection: animated scale expansion (1.03x), glowing amber shadow, and high-contrast 'PRESS OK TO SEARCH' badge
